method: Deep-copy or inject loaded in-memory objects into independent portable checker functions; no retained source, binary, oracle, trace or proof file was modified.

cases.mutation: Flip the first semantic output event value while retaining actual write evidence
cases.reason: Output event differs from actual write or game reference

cases.mutation: Replace the first semantic event instruction bytes with 90
cases.reason: Output instruction bytes/descriptor differs from PE

cases.mutation: Clear the first raw occurrence's chronological next-occurrence ID
Add 8 to the first step's recorded pre-instruction RSP delta value
Omit the first exhaustive reference case from the loaded oracle table
cases.reason: Reference lacks unique exhaustive mixed-domain coverage

cases.mutation: Set assistBinding.invert=false in the loaded UAF contract while retaining the actual draftFrame reference bindings

limits: These are targeted verifier regression probes, not an exhaustive mutation test or formal proof of verifier correctness.
The first five probes also run on the first requested chamber during ordinary portable verification; this retained observation used USE AFTER FREE.
No PE or game process was re-executed for these negative checks.
